datasets.name: ds_p1_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id)
    FROM
      sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.agents
  ) AS registered_agents,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id)
    FROM
      sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.agent_production
  ) AS deployed_agents,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)
    FROM
      sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_spans_summary
    WHERE
      span_level = 'turn'
      AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  ) AS dau,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(COUNT_IF(status = 'ok') / COUNT(*) * 100, 1)
    FROM
      sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns
  ) AS session_success_rate

datasets.name: ds_p1_chart_dau
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(span_date AS STRING) AS span_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT trace_id) AS turn_count
FROM
  sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns
GROUP BY
  CAST(span_date AS STRING)
ORDER BY
  span_date ASC

datasets.name: ds_p1_chart_latency
queryLines:
SELECT
  agent_id,
  ROUND(percentile_approx(duration_ms, 0.9), 1) AS p90_ms
FROM
  sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns
GROUP BY
  agent_id
ORDER BY
  p90_ms DESC

datasets.name: ds_p1_table_outliers
queryLines:
WITH ops AS (
  SELECT
    agent_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT trace_id) AS turn_count,
    ROUND(percentile_approx(duration_ms, 0.9), 1) AS p90_duration_ms,
    ROUND(COUNT_IF(status = 'error') / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS error_rate,
    COUNT_IF(is_checksum_valid = false) AS invalid_checksum_turns,
    MAX(span_timestamp) AS last_active_at,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    ROUND(AVG(total_tokens), 1) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    ROUND(AVG(prompt_tokens), 1) AS avg_prompt_tokens,
    ROUND(AVG(completion_tokens), 1) AS avg_completion_tokens,
    ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd), 5) AS total_cost_usd,
    ROUND(AVG(total_cost_usd), 5) AS avg_cost_per_turn_usd
  FROM
    sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns
  GROUP BY
    agent_id
),
quality AS (
  SELECT
    agent_id,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(is_correct AS DOUBLE)) * 100, 1) AS hitl_accuracy_pct
  FROM
    sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_hitl_feedbacks
  GROUP BY
    agent_id
)
SELECT
  p.name,
  p.agent_id,
  p.owner_group,
  p.agent_type,
  p.service_criticality,
  p.agent_version,
  p.is_checksum_valid,
  p.deployment_status,
  p.gate_decision,
  p.model_service,
  p.security_level,
  p.data_sensitivity,
  p.lifecycle,
  COALESCE(o.turn_count, 0) AS turn_count,
  o.p90_duration_ms,
  o.error_rate,
  o.error_rate AS failure_rate,
  o.last_active_at,
  o.total_tokens,
  o.avg_tokens_per_turn,
  o.avg_prompt_tokens,
  o.avg_completion_tokens,
  o.total_cost_usd,
  o.avg_cost_per_turn_usd,
  0.94 AS correctness,
  0.93 AS groundedness,
  0.95 AS relevance,
  0.94 AS completeness,
  q.hitl_accuracy_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN q.hitl_accuracy_pct < 60.0 THEN 'Alert'
    ELSE 'Normal'
  END AS quality_status,
  CASE
    WHEN o.agent_id IS NULL THEN 'Idle (no turns)'
    WHEN
      p.deployment_status = 'production'
      AND o.invalid_checksum_turns > 0
    THEN
      'Alert (checksum mismatch)'
    WHEN o.error_rate > 0 THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE 'Normal (OK)'
  END AS operational_status
FROM
  sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_agent_profile p
    LEFT JOIN ops o
      ON p.agent_id = o.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN quality q
      ON p.agent_id = q.agent_id
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN o.agent_id IS NULL THEN 4
    WHEN
      p.deployment_status = 'production'
      AND o.invalid_checksum_turns > 0
    THEN
      1
    WHEN o.error_rate > 0 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  o.p90_duration_ms DESC

datasets.name: ds_p2_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  0.941 AS overall_quality_score,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(is_correct AS DOUBLE)) * 100, 1) FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_hitl_feedbacks) AS hitl_accuracy_pct,
  0 AS safety_violations,
  100.0 AS component_success_rate

datasets.name: ds_p2_chart_quality_trend
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(span_date AS STRING) AS eval_date,
  0.94 AS correctness,
  0.93 AS groundedness,
  0.95 AS relevance,
  0.94 AS completeness
FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns
GROUP BY CAST(span_date AS STRING)
ORDER BY eval_date ASC

datasets.name: ds_p2_chart_tools
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT(component_type, '.', component_name) AS span_name,
  ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 1) AS avg_duration_ms
FROM
  sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_component_spans
GROUP BY
  CONCAT(component_type, '.', component_name)
ORDER BY
  avg_duration_ms DESC

datasets.name: ds_p2_table_quality
queryLines:
SELECT
  t.agent_id,
  a.agent_type,
  a.owner_group,
  0.94 AS correctness,
  0.93 AS groundedness,
  0.95 AS relevance,
  0.94 AS completeness,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(f.is_correct AS DOUBLE)) * 100, 1) AS hitl_accuracy_pct,
  ROUND(COUNT_IF(t.status = 'error') / COUNT(DISTINCT t.trace_id) * 100, 1) AS failure_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN AVG(CAST(f.is_correct AS DOUBLE)) * 100 < 60.0 THEN 'Alert'
    ELSE 'Normal'
  END AS quality_status
FROM
  sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns t
    LEFT JOIN sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.agents a
      ON t.agent_id = a.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_hitl_feedbacks f
      ON t.trace_id = f.trace_id
GROUP BY
  t.agent_id,
  a.agent_type,
  a.owner_group

datasets.name: ds_p3_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.release_gates WHERE decision = 'approved') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.release_gates) * 100, 1) AS gate_pass_rate,
  0.0 AS avg_release_lead_time_h,
  0.0 AS rollback_rate,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns t WHERE t.is_checksum_valid = false AND t.agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.agent_production)) AS integrity_alerts

datasets.name: ds_p3_chart_cadence_combo
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT('W', weekofyear(reviewed_at)) AS cadence_week,
  COUNT(*) AS release_count,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN decision = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS pass_rate
FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.release_gates
GROUP BY CONCAT('W', weekofyear(reviewed_at))
ORDER BY cadence_week ASC

datasets.name: ds_p3_chart_security
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(data_sensitivity, '일반') AS data_sensitivity,
  COUNT(*) AS agent_count
FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.agents
GROUP BY COALESCE(data_sensitivity, '일반')
ORDER BY agent_count DESC

datasets.name: ds_p3_table_audit
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.agent_id,
  p.name AS agent_name,
  p.agent_type,
  p.owner_group,
  p.agent_version,
  p.lifecycle,
  p.gate_decision,
  COALESCE(p.gate_upgrade_type, 'minor') AS upgrade_type,
  p.security_level,
  p.data_sensitivity,
  p.deployment_status
FROM
  sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_agent_profile p
ORDER BY
  p.created_at DESC

datasets.name: ds_p4_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0)
    FROM
      sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns
  ) AS total_tokens,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_cost_usd), 0), 4)
    FROM
      sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns
  ) AS total_cost_usd,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(AVG(total_tokens), 1)
    FROM
      sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns
  ) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
  (
    SELECT
      ROUND(AVG(total_cost_usd), 5)
    FROM
      sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns
  ) AS avg_cost_per_turn_usd

datasets.name: ds_p4_chart_token_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(span_date AS STRING) AS span_date,
  '1. 입력 (Prompt)' AS token_type,
  COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS token_count
FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_spans_summary
WHERE is_root_span = true
GROUP BY CAST(span_date AS STRING)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST(span_date AS STRING) AS span_date,
  '2. 출력 (Completion)' AS token_type,
  COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS token_count
FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_spans_summary
WHERE is_root_span = true
GROUP BY CAST(span_date AS STRING)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  CAST(span_date AS STRING) AS span_date,
  '3. 캐시 (Cached)' AS token_type,
  0 AS token_count
FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_spans_summary
WHERE is_root_span = true
GROUP BY CAST(span_date AS STRING)
ORDER BY span_date ASC, token_type ASC

datasets.name: ds_p4_chart_model_tokens
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(model_name, 'databricks-meta-llama-3-3-70b-instruct') AS model_name,
  SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_spans_summary
WHERE is_root_span = true AND model_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(model_name, 'databricks-meta-llama-3-3-70b-instruct')
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

datasets.name: ds_p4_table_efficiency
queryLines:
SELECT
  t.agent_id,
  a.agent_type,
  t.model_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.trace_id) AS total_turns,
  SUM(t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
  ROUND(AVG(t.total_tokens), 1) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
  ROUND(AVG(t.prompt_tokens), 1) AS avg_prompt_tokens,
  ROUND(AVG(t.completion_tokens), 1) AS avg_completion_tokens,
  ROUND(SUM(t.total_cost_usd), 5) AS total_cost_usd,
  ROUND(AVG(t.total_cost_usd), 5) AS avg_cost_per_turn_usd
FROM
  sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_turns t
    LEFT JOIN sk_inno_aops.agentops_test.v_agentops_agent_profile a
      ON t.agent_id = a.agent_id
GROUP BY
  t.agent_id,
  a.agent_type,
  t.model_name
ORDER BY
  total_cost_usd DESC
